## Review Checklist

- [ ] I understand the final diff and will address review findings.
- [ ] The change follows the relevant architecture and style rules in AGENTS.md.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior, or I explained why tests are not applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and affected wireframes match any public API changes.
- [ ] The contribution respects copyright, attribution, license compatibility, and confidentiality.
